_comment: STRUCTURELONGTAILPLAN Phase B #26 — the Aspen Manor. When the woodland-mansion seed is thrown over BWG's aspen_boreal, the jigsaw grows BWG's own aspen manor (both designs via skyseed:aspen_manor/start) in place of the vanilla dark-oak mansion, and the variant swaps the dark-oak decoration for BWG aspen trees. INERT without BWG: aspen_boreal cannot exist, so this band never matches and the vanilla mansion grows byte-identical. The base theme's evoker->Totem-of-Undying garrison (its `animals` pack, resolved from the theme not the override) is inherited, so the aspen manor keeps the mansion seed's signature reward. Surface (grass + podzol/coarse) is inherited from the base mansion palette — already aspen-appropriate.
